name: lib/observability
title: observability
summary: Structured log events with injectable sinks and the N8 covenant built in: sensitive keys are redacted and errors are reduced to { name, code } before any sink sees them.

event.shape: { ts, level, module, msg, traceId?, data? }
event.ts: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds, as Date.prototype.toISOString writes it.
event.module: The caller's module; "mzizi" when none (or empty).
event.data: The caller's data, redacted. An error in the context is added as data.error = { name, code } (an existing error key keeps its place).
event.json: One line, keys in the order ts, level, module, msg, traceId, data, escaped as JSON.stringify escapes.

redaction.keys: A key matching /pass(word)?|secret|token|authori[sz]ation|cookie|api[-_]?key|email|phone|ssn|card/i anywhere in it (ASCII case-insensitive) has its value replaced with "[redacted]", at any depth, whatever the value is.
redaction.errors: An error anywhere in data becomes { name, code } (code omitted when absent). Its message and stack never reach a sink.
redaction.depth: Objects and arrays nested 8 deep become "[depth]".
redaction.ts-only: Cycles become "[circular]", dates ISO strings, class instances "[ClassName]", functions and symbols are dropped (null in arrays), bigints strings, non-finite numbers null.

console.prefix: [mzizi:<module>] LEVEL, or [mzizi] LEVEL for the default module.
console.line: <prefix> <msg>, then ' [trace:<id>]' when there is a trace id; the TS console sink passes the redacted data as a second argument.
console.lookup: TS looks the console method up on every call, so spies and hosts that replace console see every line.

behaviour: Sinks are injectable (TS: configureObservability({ sinks, now, minLevel }), addSink, resetObservability; Rust: Logger::new(module, clock).with_sink(..)). A sink that throws is skipped; logging never throws to its caller.
log.debug/info/warn/error(message, ctx?), createLogger(module), measure(label, fn, ctx?) and trackError(error, ctx?) keep their n2 signatures; LogContext.error widens from Error to unknown.
trackError's message is the error's name (and "(code)"), never its message.

measure logs "<label> completed in <n>ms" (info) or "<label> failed after <n>ms" (error) under module perf unless given, with duration and label in data, and returns or rethrows what the function did.
signals: The N9 fundi signal (N8Signal in agent-tools fundi/src/store.ts) is produced by the N8 probes, not by this module; nothing here changes its shape.
gaps: Severity classification stays in mzizi-error-tracker and span export in mzizi-otel; this module does not duplicate them.
